notablePrerequisites:
Myojin has an indestructible counter on it.
You have max speed.
description:
Cast Slick Imitator by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Slick Imilator spell three times.
Resolve a copy of the Slick Imitator spell.
Holding priority, activate the Slick Imitator token by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When the Slick Imitator token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Slick Imitator token's ability, copying the Slick Imitator spell.
Repeat from step 3.
